title: PyPSA model_energy example
description: PyPSA's model_energy example (pypsa.examples.model_energy): one electricity node and one hydrogen node over 2019, at 3-hourly resolution (every third hour of the hourly example). A demand of 7,565 MW on average is met by wind, solar, a battery with 3 hours of storage, and hydrogen made by electrolysis, stored, and turned back into electricity by a turbine. Load shedding costs 20,000 €/MWh. The cost (TOTEX) is the annualised investment plus operating cost.

battery.description: Installed battery storage power (charge/discharge) rating. Energy capacity (MWh) equals this value times the storage unit's max_hours (3h for this model).

technology.description: Generators, links, storage units and stores of the model.

capacity.description: Installed capacity per component: power capacity (MW) for generators, links and storage units, energy capacity (MWh) for stores.
